ABOUT US – CALIFORNIA DISC JOCKEY

Bay Area DJ Experience

Since 1986, California Disc Jockey has been the heartbeat of the entire San Francisco Bay Area. Whether you are planning an elegant wedding in San Jose or a high-energy Grad School dance, Tech Event for Ai, we help you prepare for your special event from start to finish.

All About California Disc Jockey Co.

We are proud to be recognized as some of the San Francisco Bay Area’s finest wedding and event professionals. Our well-established company is one of the most highly recommended services by small businesses, large corporations, and banquet managers alike.

We deliver a First Class performance through our unwavering dedication to providing a classy, upscale, and client-focused Mobile DJ service.

Our SF Bay Area company is a well-established California Disc Jockey and one of the most recommended disc jockey services by both small and large businesses and banquet managers supporting their clients.

Get in Touch

If you have any questions or need a free price quote for our Bay Area disc jockey services, please don’t hesitate to reach out.

  • Toll-Free: 1-415-350-5474

  • Specialties: Weddings, School Dances, and Corporate Events

In conclusion, we look forward to serving you and helping you create an unforgettable celebration. We offer professional Bay Area DJs who are committed to your vision.

ABOUT THE EQUIPMENT

THE BEST MUSIC… THOUSANDS OF MUSIC TITLES SO WE CAN MAKE YOUR EVENT SPECIAL. GREAT SOUND & SPECIAL LIGHTING

  • QSC Powered Speakers
  • Serato Pioneer cd players
  • Intelligent Lighting
  • Professional Numark mixer
  • Apple Macbook Pro
  • QSC Subs
  • Gobo Monogram -Name on Wall / Floor
  • Wireless Led Uplighting (WOW)
  • Photo Booth Rental
  • Wireless Handheld Microphone
  • Schure Lapel Mic
  • Mic Stand
  • Dancing on The Clouds “Dry –Ice

Secondly For Big Events we Carry Back up:

Two Sets of 15″ QSC Concert Speakers – sound levels can be “Zoned” so we can gauge the room sounding perfect.

For Events of 800 + we can bring our 18″ Jbl Subs Up To 8 sets of Speakers For Bigger Events..

Lighting and Video Offered

[dance lighting can include]
Chauvet Swarm | ADJ American DJ Quad Gem DMX | Vertigo | Minigresser | Star gazer | Stinger | Laser | Strobes | black light | Disco Mirror ball | Intelligent Lighting | Led Uplights | Special Lighting

Karaoke and bubbles and Haze or fog/Dry Ice  as needed , Tuxedo or DJ Dressed in Suit and Tie to meet your needs. Based in San Mateo. Wedding DJs Serving All the Bay Area Cities.

SURPRISE YOUR GUESTS WITH THE BEST
Requests Encouraged, All sound and lighting is of the highest standard and is constantly maintained and checked. We also have Photo Booth and Remote Controlled Wireless Led Uplighting “any color under the rainbow” instantly.

Questions and Answers

Why Should I use you?
Personal attention puts us above the rest. We believe that a personalised service is paramount for your function to be, not only a Night to Remember but YOUR Night to Remember. Let no one offer you a Standard Dj Package, at california disc jockey there are no such things.

What can we Guarantee?
California DJ will Guarantee that your Personal and Specific Wishes are Catered for, and the Event is Customised to Your Own Unique and Individual Requirements.We endeavour to make your Event as memorable in 10 years time as it was the next morning.

We have never missed an event or been late and we always arrive early to set up.

When can we meet with you?
Upon booking you will be contacted to arrange a consultation meeting in the privacy of your own home or locally to discuss all your needs. If a meeting is not convenient alternative arrangements can be made to suit you like online or by phone.

Emergency Party Planning Available ! Stop worrying about it!
Call us ☎ 415-350-5474
Contact Us For Your Special Event

Questions & Answers – California Disc Jockey
Why Should I use you?
Personal attention puts us above the rest. We believe that a personalised service is paramount for your function to be, not only a Night to Remember but YOUR Night to Remember. At California Disc Jockey, there are no standard DJ packages—everything is tailored to you.
What can we Guarantee?
California DJ will guarantee that your personal and specific wishes are catered for, and the event is customised to your unique requirements. We have never missed an event or been late and always arrive early to set up.
When can we meet with you?
Upon booking, we will arrange a consultation meeting in your home or a local location. If that’s not convenient, we can meet online or by phone. Emergency party planning is also available to ease your worries!
How to Contact Us?
Call us ☎ 415-350-5474 or Toll-Free 1-415-350-5474 for your special event consultation.
